decision.observation: 6 mph after a 1.3 s plain throttle beat (7 to 6) yet the car has clearly advanced along the road and remains centred; five dots are now blue and the red marker is back beside the timer.
decision.hypothesis: This is the known speed-collapse phenomenon where the readout lags or drops despite real forward motion; position is what matters, so a repeat throttle beat should continue advancing the car.
decision.memory: Blue dots appeared at 6 mph here, so dot colour tracks something other than raw speed — do not rely on it. Trust world position instead.
